## Description

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link the related issue and include screenshots when changing the appearance.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or interface improvement
- [ ] Documentation or community-file update
- [ ] Indicator or data update requiring scientific review

## Validation

Describe the checks performed and any limitations.

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] I ran `quarto render` for changes affecting the website.
- [ ] Source and generated explorer changes are included together, where relevant.
- [ ] Indicator definitions and values are unchanged, or their changes are documented and validated against the source data.
- [ ] The standalone download, attribution and third-party licences are preserved.

## Contributor recognition

After merge, you may request recognition with `@all-contributors please add @YOUR-USERNAME for code, doc` once the app is enabled. See the [contribution types](https://allcontributors.org/docs/en/emoji-key). Maintainers apply the appropriate PR labels.
